AbsoluteLimits.description: The outer cap the pilot may raise limits to, plus the largest search area (read-only).
AbsoluteLimits.title: AbsoluteLimits

Ack.description: Both ways; terminal stages are sent reliable.
Ack.title: Ack

ActionRequest.description: Body of STOP, FLY HOME, Resume and Take over / Hand back.
ActionRequest.title: ActionRequest

Attitude.description:
MAVLink ATTITUDE in degrees. Roll is positive right wing down, pitch positive nose
up, yaw 0-360 clockwise from north.
Attitude.title: Attitude

AutonomyMode.description: Set only by the operator on the charter card; the AI can never change it.
AutonomyMode.title: AutonomyMode

BBox.description: A box in image pixels: top-left corner, width and height (also ``sd_detect.BBox``).
BBox.title: BBox

BoxQuestion.description: Where in an image something is (stage 2; schema only).
BoxQuestion.title: BoxQuestion

Candidate.description: A place where something that may be a person was seen. One row per revision.
Candidate.title: Candidate

CandidateAssessment.description:
One engine's view of a candidate against one profile version.

The model fills only ``person``, ``person_p``, ``fields``, ``overall`` and
``explanation_sv``; the code fills the rest. Field keys follow ``FIELD_KEY_PATTERN``;
unknown keys are dropped. ``flags`` mark claims nobody can check from a still (that
someone moves, or who they are): the panel shows them as unverified.
CandidateAssessment.title: CandidateAssessment

CandidateCard.description: One candidate as the panel's queue shows it.
CandidateCard.title: CandidateCard

CandidateDecision.description: A person's decision on a candidate. Only a logged-in person's session may send it.
CandidateDecision.title: CandidateDecision

CharterProposal.description:
A new or changed charter from the pilot (panel) or the AI.

It has no field for the autonomy mode, the mission's SafetyLimits, home or the pilot
position: sending one is rejected (unknown fields are forbidden). Its own charter
values are checked against the mission limits by the server before any card shows.
CharterProposal.title: CharterProposal

ChatIntentReport.description:
The stop check found that an operator's chat line means STOP or FLY HOME.

Sent by ``sd-brain`` to ``POST /commander/v1/missions/{id}/chat-intents``. The ground
station checks that ``message_id`` is a pilot's own, recent chat line in that mission
and names that pilot, never the AI. A line that is exactly the stop words acts like
the button; a model's reading only ever stops the vehicle where it is. It can never
release a stop.
ChatIntentReport.title: ChatIntentReport

ClearanceConfirmation.description: "Clear around the drone". Never resent after a reconnect; envelope ttl_ms <= 5000.
ClearanceConfirmation.title: ClearanceConfirmation

CropData.description: Onboard -> ground: a small JPEG cut from a still, for a detection or a view.
CropData.title: CropData

CropRequest.description: Ground -> onboard: cut a view from a stored still (a person asked to see more).
CropRequest.title: CropRequest

DetectionRow.description:
A stored detection (``GET /missions/{id}/detections``). A hint, never a decision.
``source = "oracle"`` is the simulator's own label, not a detector.
DetectionRow.title: DetectionRow

DetectorInfo.description: Which detector looked at a still, and how it went.
DetectorInfo.title: DetectorInfo

Find.description:
One found object: detections of one class at the same place, joined
(``GET /missions/{id}/finds``, live ``find.new`` / ``find.updated``). Not confirmed:
only a person confirms.
Find.title: Find

FindMeParams.description: Stage 2. Unresolved here: the operator's position is checked onboard.
FindMeParams.title: FindMeParams

FollowMeParams.description: Stage 2. Unresolved here: the operator's position is checked onboard.
FollowMeParams.title: FollowMeParams

FollowPathParams.description:
Fly a drawn line point by point at one height, then hover at its last point.

``points`` come from the pilot's drawn path (sd-brain resolves ``pa-<n>``, and the
ground checks that they are that path's points); the model never writes them.
``label`` is that path's name, for the card and the map.
FollowPathParams.title: FollowPathParams

FollowTrackParams.description: Stage 2. The target moves; every set-point is checked onboard. Unresolved here.
FollowTrackParams.title: FollowTrackParams

GateTargets.description:
Where an order would take the vehicle. The gate checks every item against the limits.

``path`` holds the corner points of the route (current position first); the gate
samples it before checking: exact segment/polygon intersection, or samples no further
apart than half the fence buffer. When ``speed_ms`` is None the gate checks the
executor's default speed. ``resolved = False`` means the targets could not be
worked out (unknown sector, unknown position, a target that only exists onboard);
the gate must then reject an order that moves the vehicle.
GateTargets.title: GateTargets

GeoDetectionMsg.description: One detection, placed on the map. A hint for a person to look at, never a find.
GeoDetectionMsg.title: GeoDetectionMsg

Heartbeat.description: Both ways, 1 Hz, not reliable, never acknowledged.
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat

Hello.description: Onboard -> ground, the first message on a connection.
Hello.title: Hello

HelloAck.description: Ground -> onboard, within 1 s of Hello.
HelloAck.title: HelloAck

InspectDetectionParams.description: Stage 2. The detection's position exists only onboard: always unresolved here.
InspectDetectionParams.title: InspectDetectionParams

Keepout.description: A no-fly cylinder around a possible person.
Keepout.title: Keepout

KeepoutInstall.description:
Ground -> onboard: the whole list of ground cylinders; it replaces the previous one.

``install_seq`` grows with every list; a lower one than the last seen is ignored, so a
late resend never brings back a removed cylinder or drops a new one. The installed
list stays in force until a list with a higher ``install_seq`` arrives: the envelope's
``ttl_ms`` only limits how late the message may be delivered, never how long the
cylinders apply.
KeepoutInstall.title: KeepoutInstall

LastSeen.description: The initial planning point (IPP): where and when the person was last seen.
LastSeen.title: LastSeen

LimitCaps.description:
The outer cap a pilot may raise ``SafetyLimits`` to, per mission and by click only.

Read by the ground station from its local settings file; the owner sets it freely.
A cap is never below the standard values, and the battery floor and lowest height
can never be loosened.
LimitCaps.title: LimitCaps

LinkLossPhase.description:
Where the onboard link-loss rule is (sd_onboard.executor.link_loss).

Times count from the last inbound SD-link message.
LinkLossPhase.title: LinkLossPhase

LinkLossPlan.description:
What the ground expects the onboard link-loss rule to do while SD-link is down: the
same ``sd_safety.link_loss.choose_mode`` on the last snapshot and keep-out list. The
panel counts down to these times; the flight controller's real mode (over MAVLink,
when it is up) wins where they differ.
LinkLossPlan.title: LinkLossPlan

ManualControl.description:
Kept in the catalogue for compatibility; v0.1.0 never sends it over SD-link.

The ground station sends the sticks straight to the flight controller and stops
after ``MANUAL_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_MS`` without a new value, so the vehicle stands
still in LOITER.
ManualControl.title: ManualControl

ManualControlInput.description: Panel -> ground (WebSocket op "manual"), 10-20 Hz while the pilot steers.
ManualControlInput.title: ManualControlInput

ManualControlState.description: Whether the pilot is steering by hand (Ta över) and since when.
ManualControlState.title: ManualControlState

ManualTakeover.description:
Ground -> onboard, reliable. The pilot takes over (Ta över) or hands back (Lämna tillbaka).

On ``active = True`` the AI's orders pause onboard (HELD). The ground station puts
the vehicle in LOITER and sends the pilot's sticks itself as MAVLink MANUAL_CONTROL
from the GCS id (250/190), the way STOP goes; the onboard computer forwards no
sticks. The flight controller's limits and geofence still apply. A physical RC
transmitter always wins.
ManualTakeover.title: ManualTakeover

MapImagery.description: An aerial photo pack (raster PMTiles) drawn under the map's roads, paths and names.
MapImagery.title: MapImagery

MarkLocationParams.description: A map marker on the ground; it does not move the vehicle.
MarkLocationParams.title: MarkLocationParams

MissionCharter.description: An approved (or proposed) charter. Fields marked *server* are set by the ground station.
MissionCharter.title: MissionCharter

MissionMemory.description: What the server stores and returns.
MissionMemory.title: MissionMemory

MissionMemoryUpdate.description: What sd-brain sends (PUT .../memory). The server adds ``updated_at``.
MissionMemoryUpdate.title: MissionMemoryUpdate

NoulQuestion.description: Yes/no. The answer is the probability that the statement is true.
NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion

OperatorCommandRequest.description: An order from the pilot, e.g. an order button. Same gate and latch as the AI's orders.
OperatorCommandRequest.title: OperatorCommandRequest

OperatorLatch.description: Set by STOP, FLY HOME, the battery guard or the watchdog. Only Resume lifts it.
OperatorLatch.title: OperatorLatch

OperatorOverrideNotice.description: Ground -> onboard: STOP, FLY HOME, battery or watchdog. Never from the AI.
OperatorOverrideNotice.title: OperatorOverrideNotice

OperatorRelease.description: Ground -> onboard; only from the pilot's Resume click.
OperatorRelease.title: OperatorRelease

PerceptionReport.description: Onboard -> ground: what the detector found in one still.
PerceptionReport.title: PerceptionReport

Pose.description: Where the camera was at exposure, interpolated from telemetry.
Pose.title: Pose

ProposeCharterChangeParams.description: Validated as a charter proposal by the ground station, never by the gate.
ProposeCharterChangeParams.title: ProposeCharterChangeParams

ResumeParams.description: Continue the step interrupted by hold. The gate rechecks the remaining route.
ResumeParams.title: ResumeParams

ReturnHomeParams.description: Always allowed geometrically: flying home must never be blocked by a missing target.
ReturnHomeParams.title: ReturnHomeParams

SafetyLimits.description: Per-mission limits (outer layer). Heights are metres above the home point.
SafetyLimits.title: SafetyLimits

ScoreQuestion.description: Place the state on an ordered scale ``0 .. max_score``.
ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion

SearchProfile.description:
What the person looked like, as the operator approved it.

A proposal from the AI has ``approved_by = None`` and is never used for matching.
The age and height bands are for the people searching, never for the matching.
SearchProfile.title: SearchProfile

SkillCommand.description: Ground -> onboard, reliable; envelope ttl_ms = the registry's ttl_s x 1000.
SkillCommand.title: SkillCommand

SkillSpecPublic.description: What ``GET /commander/v1/skills`` returns: a ``SkillSpec`` with JSON Schemas.
SkillSpecPublic.title: SkillSpecPublic

StateRef.description: Which state picture an order was based on (onboard StateSnapshot epoch and sequence).
StateRef.title: StateRef

StateSnapshot.description: Onboard -> ground, 2 Hz, not reliable. What only the onboard computer knows.
StateSnapshot.title: StateSnapshot

StickAxes.description: Stick values. Axes are -1..1; ``throttle`` 0..1 with 0.5 = hold height (LOITER).
StickAxes.title: StickAxes

StopFollowParams.description: Stop following and hover. A later ``resume`` goes through the gate on its own.
StopFollowParams.title: StopFollowParams

SurveySectorParams.description: Search a polygon or a sector. The ground replaces ``sector_id`` with its polygon.
SurveySectorParams.title: SurveySectorParams

Telemetry.description: From the ground station's own MAVLink channel.
Telemetry.title: Telemetry

WindCheck.description:
The ground station's "too windy" warning. A warning only: nothing on board or on
the ground acts on it, and STOP and FLY HOME are unchanged. Its thresholds are not yet
calibrated against flight logs, so ``calibrated`` is always false for now.

* ``TILT_MARGIN``: the mean tilt over the last 10 s in the air is within 10 degrees of
  the flight controller's lean limit (ATC_ANGLE_MAX).
* ``ENERGY_HOME``: flying home now at RTL speed, at the measured current with a 30 %
  margin, would leave less than the flight controller's low-battery reserve.
* ``WIND_LIMIT``: the flight controller's own wind estimate (MAVLink WIND, only sent
  when EK3_DRAG_* are set) is over the configured wind limit.
WindCheck.title: WindCheck
